items.q: What happens after I fill out this form?
items.a: A technical lead will review your submission and email you to schedule a 30-minute introductory call. During that call, we'll discuss your business goals, tech stack, and determine if there's a mutual fit.
Yes, for projects with highly rigid and pre-defined scopes. However, we generally recommend Agile retainers (Time & Materials) as it allows for much greater flexibility and faster time-to-market.

items.q: Can we hire a single developer or do we need a full team?
items.a: We primarily deploy full cross-functional pods (e.g., 1 Lead, 2 Frontend, 1 Backend, 1 QA). However, we do offer staff augmentation for specific senior roles if you already have an established engineering culture.

items.q: Do you work with startups seeking equity exchanges?
items.a: We generally operate on a standard fee-for-service model. We do not accept equity in lieu of payment, ensuring you keep full ownership of your company.
We are a remote-first team headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan, with engineers across multiple time zones to ensure overlap with US, European, and MENA clients.
Absolutely. We can use your standard NDA or provide our own mutual NDA before discussing any sensitive IP.
